newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian CLB bank acts as insurance broker.
newsitem.headline: Belgian CLB bank acts as insurance broker.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Belgium (CLB), a unit of French Credit Lyonnais, is working as an insurance broker for several foreign insurers, CLB said on Tuesday.

In life insurance, the bank offers its clients insurance products from British insurer Norwich Union, French insurer Cardif France (owned by Compagnie Bancaire/Paribas ) and Le Mans International. In fire insurance, CLB offers products from British Sun Alliance.
"This strategy makes us a real insurance broker," CLB retail director Yves Delacollette told a news conference.

Asked why no Belgian insurers offered their products via CLB, he said that there had been contacts, but that Belgian players did not want to undercut their own product range by offering agressively priced products via CLB.
"We compete on price mainly," he said.
The insurance product line -- along with mortgage loans and free current accounts -- is part of a new CLB strategy to offer a complete banking and insurance product line.
In recent years, niche player CLB has competed agressively with Belgium's large banks in the savings and investment section of the business, but left other areas untouched.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
